newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese, German yield spreads seen narrowing.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese, German yield spreads seen narrowing.

text.p: Yield spreads between Portuguese Treasury bonds and German Bunds should narrow as Economic and Monetary Union (EMU) approaches, Treasury Director-General Vitor Bento said.

"Regarding the reduction in yield spreads, one thing is certain: in three years' time, rates will be equal or nearly equal," Bento told reporters during a signing ceremony for a Navigator bond contract.
Ten-year Portuguese bond yields are presently 7.59 percent, compared with Spanish government bond yields of 7.75 percent and German Bund yields of 5.99 percent.
The yield spreads against Bunds will fall gradually, as they have done in recent weeks, Bento said.
He was speaking at the signing ceremony for a 20 billion escudo 20-year Navigator loan by the European Investment Bank (EIB), which is led by Banco Comercial Portugues.
